text: I think you'll really enjoy this Thai Chicken With Basil and Coconut Milk recipe, given your preferences for chicken and your dietary constraint of being gluten-free. The dish is also relatively quick to prepare, which fits within your 45-minute time budget. Additionally, the coconut milk and fish sauce provide a rich and savory flavor profile that should satisfy your taste buds. With 26 grams of protein per serving, this recipe aligns with your health goal of increasing your protein intake.
